svg.title: Cloud & IAM Audit: Identity, storage, logging and policy review across AWS and Azure.
svg.desc: Cloud & IAM Audit. Identity, storage, logging and policy review across AWS and Azure. Offense: over-permissive IAM, storage exposure, logging gaps, weak policy. Defense: board-level risk language + prioritised remediation roadmap. Tools: IAM, CSPM, Zero Trust, Policy Review.
